changelog:
dead-code-cleaner v0.1.0

- Initial release supporting multi-stage dead code detection and safe removal based on codebase-memory-mcp knowledge graphs.
- Handles both single-repo and monorepo structures; automatically detects and processes per sub-project.
- Supports all programming languages, with precision verification for major stacks (JS/TS/Vue/React/Python/Java/Go/Rust/C/C++/PHP/C#).
- Employs an 11-stage workflow with multi-layer validation before deletion, including orphaned file cascade detection and byte-identical duplicate scanning.
- Includes robust pre-checks for environment & MCP tool availability, and visualizes results using a 3D code map.
- Guides parameter parsing and live user prompts for ambiguous cases; outputs cleanup summary via standardized template.
